name: Vergara
title: Head Blacksmith

onTalk.when: state CREATED; NOT ((talker.getLevel() >= MIN_LVL) && hasQuestItems(talker, ROYAL_MEMBERSHIP))

villagemaster/30687.htm.text: Head Blacksmith Vergara: I am Head Blacksmith Vergara of the Black Anvil guild's Hunters Village branch. I train skillful Artisans so they can become useful Warsmiths. Warsmith is the best occupation to earn great amounts of money. Do you wish to become a Warsmith?
villagemaster/30687.htm.dpText: Head Blacksmith Vergara: I'm Head Blacksmith Vergara of the Black Anvil Guild here in Hunter Village. It's my job to take qualified Artisans and transform them into talented Warsmiths. If you want to make money, there's nothing better than being a Warsmith. Interested?

links.dpText: Listen to information about second class transfer.

Q00382_KailsMagicCoin/30687-02.htm.text: Head Blacksmith Vergara: I'm honored to finally meet royalty! The heavens at last have smiled upon me! As a royal, you must have many rare coins, am I right? You know, I have many rare items, too. Would you be interested in trading with me? All my products are guaranteed top-notch.

Q00382_KailsMagicCoin/30687-01.htm.text: Head Blacksmith Vergara: I can't remember the last time I saw royalty! Sigh... (This quest may only be undertaken by a royal character of level 55 or above.)
when: state CREATED; NOT ((talker.getLevel() >= MIN_LVL) && hasQuestItems(talker, ROYAL_MEMBERSHIP))

Q00382_KailsMagicCoin/30687-04.htm.text: Head Blacksmith Vergara: I have many kinds of weapons. Take one or take them all!

links.text: "Tell me about the members of the coin collecting club."

Q00382_KailsMagicCoin/30687-03.htm.text: Head Blacksmith Vergara: Ah, yes! The forthrightness of a true royal! I'll get right to the point. Here is a list of the coins I want and what I have to offer in exchange. Being in the warehouse business, I've acquired many rare and precious items. I'm offering them to you at an exceptional price. …

Q00382_KailsMagicCoin/30687-05.htm.text: Head Blacksmith Vergara: You'll find Sorcerer Kail on the Forsaken Plains, and there you'll find the coins as well, likely in the possession of the filthy orcs that infest that place. You could also probably win some by gambling with other players...

Q00382_KailsMagicCoin/30687-06.htm.text: Head Blacksmith Vergara: Although I've only just joined, I already know all of our members by heart!
